style: Photorealistic, high detail, clean beauty e-commerce photography. Palette: soft blush pink, warm nude, cream and beige neutrals with black accents, lots of soft natural light; minimal, elegant and premium like a modern skincare brand. No text, no letters, no logos, no brand names, no watermark.

images.prompt: Two joyful Latin American women (Peruvian) with glowing natural skin, laughing and hugging, bare shoulders, standing on the right half of the frame; plain soft blush-pink studio backdrop, the left half clean and empty for headline text. Wide beauty campaign photo.

images.prompt: Elegant glass perfume bottles of different shapes on travertine stone blocks with dried pampas grass and soft shadows, placed on the right half; warm nude beige backdrop, left half empty for text. Wide still life campaign photo.
